Package index

Main Functions

Main functions for data preparation, model calibration, and scoring.

prep()
This file includes utilities of bspam package.
get.cases()
Returns cases (person and occasion) applied in [fit.model] function.
fit.model()
Estimate the model parameters
scoring()
Estimate factor scores with task-level model

Plotting Functions

Functions for visualizing calibration and scoring results.

plot(<task>)
Plot function to show graph of fit.model class
plot(<person>)
Plot function to show graph of scoring class
plot(<wcpm>)
Plot function to show graph of wcpm information from scoring class
plot(<information>)
Plot function to show information of calibration

Advanced and Utility Functions

Additional exported functions for advanced analyses and data processing.

fit.model.testlet()
Fit model with testlet
run.mcem()
Base function for fitting the speed-accuracy model by MCEM
agg.word()
agg.word function to aggregate word information to sentence or passage level
desc.data()
desc.data function to describe data information

Example Data and Results

Example data sets and calibration results included with bspam.

passage2
Passage-level Oral Reading Fluency assessment data set
sentence.level.data
Sentence-level Oral Reading Fluency assessment data set
sentence.cens.low
Sentence-level data set with low censoring
sentence.cens.high
Sentence-level data set with high censoring
passage.calib.mcem
Task calibration example output object by MCEM
passage.calib.bayes
Task calibration example output object by Bayes
